office_active_unlabeled_avg_text_length: SELECT AVG(LENGTH(r.body)) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.category='office products' AND p.ref_id=r.ref_id AND p.status='active' WHERE r.verification_label IS NULL AND r.body IS NOT NULL
office_active_labeled_avg_text_length: SELECT AVG(LENGTH(r.body)) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.category='office products' AND p.ref_id=r.ref_id AND p.status='active' WHERE r.verification_label IS NOT NULL AND r.body IS NOT NULL
